description: Figure 4 presents a line plot illustrating the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating, with the caption noting that the baseline and post-gating values are similar. The plot displays three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gating (with an average value of 0.03), an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after gating (average 0.44), and a green dashed line for the sparsity ratio after average gating (average 0.33). The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue line remains low and relatively flat across the layer range, while the orange line starts near 1.0 and decreases sharply to around 0.2 before fluctuating slightly. The green line follows a similar decreasing trend as the orange line but remains consistently lower throughout.
